name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.257.0 — spec-status derives a fourth brief status, superseded, for roadmap briefs carrying a Superseded by banner with no spec in flight: the roadmap renders them as their own ⛔ collapsed run instead of folding them into the ⬜ unplanned count, the --next fallback pick never recommends planning one, and --json/--brief report the status as superseded. 7.256.0 — /spec:plan's lock now runs decision-lint.js: a Decisions row that withholds a user affordance must carry [guards: <host § Risk Tiers text>] or [asked: <choice>], and a deferral row must cite a queue id spec-queue resolves; the plan ledger row records decisionLint counts. 7.255.0 — /spec:fix refuses to start on a dirty working tree: step 1 runs git status --porcelain first and STOPs naming the files, so one checkout carries one fix at a time and the gate, the reviewer and the fix row judge a single root cause. Fits the shipped read-load budget by tightening the intro and rules prose.
